name: concept-leaf-view
description: Renders a com.semanticops.spec/concept record as a document leaf: the description reads as the record's own prose immediately under its heading (labelMode: none, srs#794/#827), while notes and examples keep their labels since they are supplementary to the description rather than the record's primary content. canonical_key is hidden: it is an internal cross-reference key, not reading prose, and duplicating it under every heading added no value (srs#794 evidence: docs/spec/srs-spec.md before this View showed '**Canonical Key**: record:concepts/stable-identity' printed between the heading and the description on every concept record).
